purpose: Development-only paired proposal-opportunity and action-refresh diagnostic; no scorer fitting or gate
sampling: Fixed complete task x seed grids; retain ties/failures; same full proposal bank, source state and repeat seeds in both prefix conditions; no outcome-based advancement or filtering
endpoint: ever-success; stop branches and source policy on success/termination/truncation or absolute step400
forecast_audit: Unroll all50 clipped actions (ten JEPA transitions); compare separate ten-action unroll to first two transitions; encode physical futures every5 actions, masking frames after first stop. No outcomes are model inputs
value_scorers: None: old ten-action scorer/ranker semantics are not transferred to50 actions

runtime.advancement: Pilot must pass replay/finite prediction/prefix equivalence. Start each complete three-task main seed shard only when worst-case pilot timing estimate fits its45-minute timeout and remaining100-minute budget. Runtime-only stopping is recorded as partial; never report partial as completed six-episode grid

analysis: Episode means and paired prefix contrasts, both nested banks; base/always-one/random/best measured offline controls; helpful/harmful opportunity and early-prefix success separately; common support forecast error vs persistence; no bootstrap claims from correlated branches; no gate or closed-loop result
execution_revision: Whole episodes instead of three-task seed shards; pilot technical timing only; main outcomes not inspected

main_runtime.order: seed-major, task list order; complete episodes only; resume remaining fixed identifiers under identical declaration
